description: Defines functions and data structures for determining default and specific PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) time-domain resource allocations in 5G NR, based on 3GPP TS 38.214 specifications. Includes functions for default allocations, table generation, and allocations for different RNTI types.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Calculates the default PDSCH time-domain resource allocation for a given cyclic prefix, row index, and DM-RS position based on 3GPP TS 38.214.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Generates a table of default PDSCH time-domain resource allocations for a given cyclic prefix and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations for a specific search space configuration, active BWP, and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with SI-RNTI Type0, based on cyclic prefix and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_type0A_common_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with SI-RNTI Type0A, based on common configuration, cyclic prefix, and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_ra_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with RA-RNTI, based on common configuration, cyclic prefix, and DM-RS position.
